resources.string: Control your PC over your local network.\nNo cloud, no account.

How to connect:

1. On the PC, double-click start.bat in the pc-remote folder.
2. Connect this phone to the same Wi-Fi (or the PC's hotspot).
3. The PC appears above automatically — tap it. Or tap Scan QR and point at the PC screen.

Works over Wi-Fi, hotspot, USB tethering and Bluetooth tethering.

Tip: long-press a saved PC to remove it.
Point the camera at the QR code on the PC screen

Could not reach the PC.

Make sure:
✓ the PC server is running
✓ this phone is on the same Wi-Fi
✓ Windows Firewall allows the app
